t: This is All Saints Church, the parish church of West Ham in east London. It has been a Grade I listed building since 1984, which puts it among the most highly protected buildings in the country. Baynbrigg Buckeridge is buried here. He was an English writer on art, born in 1668 and died in 1733. Beyond that, I don't have more detail on the church or on him, so I'll leave it there rather than guess.
